facebook.caption:
POV: you took the road north and found Ong Lang beach before the crowds did.

No beach clubs blasting EDM. No hawkers every 10 meters. Just soft sand, calm water, and maybe 12 other people on a Saturday.

4.1 stars across 750 reviews. Quiet beaches don't usually rack up numbers like that.

Rent a scooter, head north from town, and give yourself two hours here. You'll stay four.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
facebook.video_caption: Scooter parked. Shoes off. Ong Lang beach has maybe 15 people on it right now. This is Phu Quoc without the noise. 4.1 stars, 750 reviews, and somehow still this empty.
